highlighted_projects.description: Built an end-to-end analytics and ML workflow to evaluate how virtual reality (VR) adoption influences student engagement and collaboration. Cleaned and transformed survey/learning datasets in Python, performed exploratory analysis, and designed interactive Tableau dashboards to communicate key trends. Trained an XGBoost classifier to predict learning outcome improvement, engineered features (e.g., engagement ratio), and evaluated results using precision, accuracy, and confusion matrices to recommend targeted VR deployment strategies.
highlighted_projects.name: Virtual Reality Impact Analysis on Student Engagement

highlighted_projects.description: Developed an NLP-driven analytics pipeline to analyze over 5,000 student reviews and extract insights into professor performance and teaching effectiveness. Cleaned and processed unstructured text data, applied sentiment analysis using VADER, and clustered professors based on feedback patterns using Scikit-learn. Integrated OpenAI APIs to extract nuanced character traits from comments and built interactive Power BI dashboards (served via Flask) to deliver clear, actionable insights for academic decision-making.
highlighted_projects.name: Analysis of Student Perception of Professors

highlighted_projects.description: Designed and evaluated machine learning models to distinguish between human-written and AI-generated text at scale. Performed extensive text preprocessing and feature engineering using TF-IDF and Word2Vec embeddings, applied dimensionality reduction with PCA, and trained binary and multi-class classifiers. Achieved strong classification performance using Random Forest and MLP models, validated results with cross-validation and confusion matrices, and optimized models for scalability through hyperparameter tuning and model serialization.
highlighted_projects.name: Human vs LLM Text Classification

jarvis_projects.description: Built an end-to-end Python Data Analytics project focused on transforming raw retail transaction data into business-ready insights. The project involved extensive data cleaning and validation (handling missing customer IDs, cancellations, negative quantities, and outliers), exploratory data analysis, and KPI development such as total revenue, average order value, active customers, revenue per customer, customer concentration, and RFM segmentation. Analysis was performed using Python with Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib, supported by SQL for data extraction and validation, and Jupyter Notebooks for reproducible analysis. The outcome was a structured, insight-driven analytics workflow designed to support executive-level decision making through clear metrics, visualizations, and data-backed narratives.
